readme:
Plugin Website: http://www.gforcesoftware.com/
Plugin Name: Mtron Pro full version
Plugin Version Tested to work: 1
Wizard Written and tested by Matthew Skinner

Known Issues: None, plugin is not written to support patch changes so CHUNK support needs to be used with lots of banks and presets for each sound.

Special Installation steps:
You must install the library files to "c:/Program Files/M-Tron Pro Library" and start the plugin on the pc and ensure the PC plugin can find the files in that location
this info is stored in a pref file which is copied over so you must do this before importing the DLL into the vfx application.
If you want to use another location then you would need to edit the 
wizard file in two places the dirs to copy and also the symlink which saves you from editing the pref file.
Secondly you must edit the wizard and enter your serial number that you use to unlock the program, the wizard has XXXX in the serial 
number format.


How to reduce size: cant get it any smaller as it is already very streamlined as this wizard does not copy the pdfs ect.

How to install the plugin onto the VMachine:
1. Install the plugin to your computer first. It must be C:
2. Open the VFX application.
3. Click on the orange power icon in the VFX application and from the menu that will appear select 'import vst instrument or effect'
4. Browse to the 'vstplugins' folder and select the plugins DLL file.
5. Browse to the 'vfxinfo.txt' file that is in this ZIP file.
6. Insert and setup the plugin inside the vfx application.
7. turn up the mixers faders, both the chanels fader and also the master fader.
8. Save the bank and preset you wish to send to the vmachine and then you can upload the plugin with the bank in a number of ways, for more 
info see the VMachine manual and supporting documents.
9. You can delete/prune back some of the files and registry entries to reduce the size of the plugin so that it takes up less room on the 
vmachine. Examples of what are not needed are PDF files, uninstall programs and other log files.

I prefer to copy the plugs and banks folders to a usb memory stick, you can then tell the VMachine to 'import selected bank' aka copy 
the plugin from the memory stick to the internal flash. To do this Scroll to a bank enclosed in square brackets eg [name of bank] 
and then use the menu>'import selected bank' option to copy the bank and plugin.
Copying this way is the fastest method. Once the plugin is on the Vmachine you can use the sync feature to update
banks and presets very quickly without using a memory stick.

readme:
Plugin Website: http://www.yellowtools.com/
Download demo by: creating a user account, login and then register serial number 'inde-free' as serial. Full instructions are at
http://www.yellowtools.us/cp21/cms/index.php?id=842
Plugin Name: Independence Free 2.0
Plugin Version Tested to work: 2.0.0
Written and tested by Matthew Skinner on 24-12-2008

Extra Steps needed to get wizard to work: This is important so please read otherwise the wizard will fail to import the plugin. Open the vfxinfo.txt
file in WORDPAD or a text editor like VIM as you need to edit a path as follows...

/Documents and Settings/ENTER USER NAME HERE/Application Data/Yellow Tools/Independence Free/settings.cfg
change this line so that you replace the "ENTER USER NAME HERE" with the name you log into windows with. If you click on the start bar this will
be displayed up the top next to a pretty little picture. If you log in as Administrator then this line will become..

/Documents and Settings/Administrator/Application Data/Yellow Tools/Independence Free/settings.cfg

The second step is that this file is only created after running independence free and telling it where the 'Independence Free Root Folder' is
located. So edit the vfxinfo.txt
file with your user name and run the plugin so it knows where the root folder is located. Be sure to use the default location which is.
C:\Program Files\yellow tools Independence Free 2.0\Independence Free Root Folder
also all the sounds go into the image files folder which is.
C:\Program Files\yellow tools Independence Free 2.0\Independence Free Root Folder\image files

End of extra steps.

Helpful Info:
Use a download manager like http://www.freedownloadmanager.org/download.htm so if your download fails part way you dont need to restart
downloading the large files from yellow tools website. They sell a DVD with all the files from their website for users who can't 
download it or wish not to use large amounts of bandwidth.

Known Issues for Plugin: There are a 1 or 2 so please read them all, dont let this stop you from downloading and trying the plugin
as it is my favourite plugin and sounds amazing and works very well with low cpu usage.

* Plugin does not like you playing midi notes when changing sounds or starting/stopping the plugin. Since some keyboards
will send 'active sense notes' if you have problems with the plugin hanging when loading or just after loading a new sound then unplug the 
keyboard from the vmachine until the
plugin is fully loaded. If you have a USB Drive with a led that flashes when the drive is in use, wait until the light stops flashing and then 
your good to go. This is usually a few seconds after the plugin appears on the vmachine screen.

* Plugin needs to be closed before closing the VFX application on your computer or else the VFX program does not close correctly and will need to
have the task ended before you can start the VFX app again.

* Plugin uses image Files which are very large so running this from an external usb HDD or large and fast memory stick is a good idea. You could
copy only the image files need for a particular sound that you like and it may be possible to get it running on the internal flash.

Contact yellowtools and ask them if they can fix these in a newer release.

How to get the plugin smaller in size: You can delete the 'documentation' folder which is 50mb of PDF files and
also only copy over the needed image files for the sounds that you use. Doing this is should be possible to reduce
the size down to 400mb if your only after 1 of the sounds.

How to install the plugin onto the VMachine:
1. Install the plugin to your computer first. It must be C: and please install with all default locations so they match this wizard file.
2. Open the VFX application.
3. Click on the orange power icon in the VFX application and from the menu that will appear select 'import vst instrument or effect'
4. Browse to the 'vstplugins' folder and select the plugins DLL file. If it is not here then browse to the folder where the DLL file resides.
5. Browse to the 'vfxinfo.txt' file that is in this ZIP file when asked for the 'plugin information file'. Wait until all the files are copied
which may take a while if the plugin is large or has big sample files.
6. Insert and setup the plugin inside the vfx application.
7. turn up the mixers faders, both the chanels fader and also the master fader. You should then have sound and be able to use the plugin on 
the host computer.
8. Save the bank and preset you wish to send to the vmachine, and then you can upload the plugin with the bank in a number of ways, for more 
info see the VMachine manual and supporting documents or just below for my preferred method.
9. You can delete/prune back some of the files and registry entries to reduce the size of the plugin so that it takes up less room on the 
vmachine. Examples of what are not needed are PDF files, uninstall programs and other log files.

Getting the plugin onto the VMachine using USB flash sticks or USB hard drives:

I prefer to copy the plugs and banks folders to a usb memory stick or usb hard drive. They MUST be formatted as FAT32 which has a limitation 
of being 32gb or smaller. If this method does not work then it will be because the USB drive is not formatted as FAT32. Google how to do this, 
also you can partition a large drive to have a 32gb partition for fat32 and still use the rest on another partition.
Once the USB drive has the 'plugs' and 'banks' folders on it then you can plug this into the vmachine and it will detect and mount the plugins
automatically if you have firmware 1212 or newer installed.
Scroll across until you see the bank enclosed by square brackets [new bank] this means it is located on the USB drive. When this is displayed do
the following to copy the bank, presets and plugin onto the Vmachine if it has room left on the internal flash drive...
Hold down both MENU buttons on the vmachine.
Press MENU LEFT once and you should see 'import selected bank ?'
Press the button next to 'confirm'
and the bank, presets in that bank, chunk files and the plugin is all copied across. Provided the internal drive has enough room. If it does not
fit in the case of Independence Free and all its image files then you will have to run the plugin from a USB drive. Having a fast usb drive
may be required for the plugin the run well, cheaper memory sticks tend to be slower than more expensive ones.

vendorNotes:
It was back in the fifties when German inventor Ernst Zacharias invented one of the funkiest keyboards of all times. At first the intention was to make a portable version of a cembalo, but it soon turned into one of the most used keyboards in rock and pop music. You will certainly recognize it in the famous pop song "Superstition", and in many other funky tunes of the seventies. Many police and investigation story movies and TV shows of the 70's and the early 80's had music themes based on funky accompaniments made with the D6, a slap bass and drums. This instrument can reproduce the sound of an electric guitar and can be treated with the same effects used by guitarists (wahwah, distortion, phaser, chorus, etc.) for both rhythmic and melodic textures, since it is actually based on a set of 60 strings and two humbucker pickups very similar to those used in electric guitars.
